## Research projects

I directly contribute and partially manage the following projects.

::: {.project-card}
### [Q-GeneSys](https://www.iis.fraunhofer.de/de/ff/lv/dataanalytics/anwproj/q-genesys.html)

We develop early fault-tolerance methods for generative quantum models.
